title: Chris Ramsay sees tic tac over Nellis

tellings.quote: He was flying a commercial flight over Nellis testing range and he saw that that tic tac that I showed you guys.

plain: A man named Chris Ramsay is said to have seen a "tic tac", a white oval object shaped like the mint, while he was a passenger on a commercial flight over the Nellis test range, a military range in Nevada. Michels passes this on from what Ramsay told him. He says Ramsay saw the same kind of tic tac Michels had just shown on screen, so the shape would be turning up in more than one place.
